error[ZBX-E0812]: a Dockerfile variable has no value
  cause  Dockerfile:5 uses `VERSION`, an ARG with no default and no --build-arg
  fix    give ARG VERSION a default, or pass it with --build-arg in the build file
  more   zbx explain E0812 · rerun with --verbose for the full cause chain
  docs   https://zigbox.github.io/zigbox/errors/E0812.html
